ideas.title: The Minnesota Child Care Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the fraud in Minnesota's child care program and the involvement of state and federal agencies
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the oversight and management of child care funds
questions: What was the role of state and federal agencies?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in a critical social program, and could lead to important reforms.
